annotation_checking_evidence.summary: The non-force contract appends exactly sublist 0 actual input to the canonical logical FIFO, changes exactly the written option-valued ring positions, preserves all untouched None/Some cells, and returns the canonical backing resource consumed by Read/DataLength/Release. Force mode records only the exact descriptor and mixed-buffer effect and does not fabricate a logical FIFO.
findings: Actual non-force length is min(requested, area_length - Zlength logical), and logical_after is logical ++ sublist 0 actual input.
CircularAreaPhysicalWrite is extensional: written modular positions contain Some input bytes and all other option cells retain their prior values.
The public non-force success postcondition returns CircularAreaBackingResource, so Init output composes into Write and Write output composes into Read/DataLength/Release.
The shared CircularAreaLogicalState permits either status when indices differ and uses equal indices plus status to distinguish empty from full.
Force success uses CircularAreaForceWriteResource rather than weakening the canonical resource or inventing values for uninitialized cells.
Builtin UCharArray full/seg and mixed_full/mixed_seg predicates are reused; no duplicate array memory predicate was introduced.
The implementation contains no loops; complete branch assertions connect helper results, physical slices, and the final mathematical postcondition.
No Admitted, extra Axiom, compatibility CircularAreaDescriptorState, split diagnostic fragment, or forbidden generated-artifact import was introduced.
